title: Primo Assalto di Spada da Due Mani
citation: Achille Marozzo, Opera Nova · Bologna, 1536 · Libro III, cap. 161
subtitle: Achille Marozzo, Opera Nova (Bologna, 1536), Book III, chapter 161
refrain: The closing refrain: roverso fendente into coda longa e alta; gather the left foot and parry in guardia di croce, point to the face; right foot two spans back, rising falso to the hands, settle in porta di ferro alta.

faccial: Guardia di faccia, left foot forward

parts.title: Prima parte
steps: Feint a falso impuntato outside his sword
Mandritto to the head with a tramazzone
He attacks: parry with the true edge, thrust to his face
right foot steps across in front of the left
left foot steps to his right side
He attacks again: cross the arms, point to his face
left foot steps up to the right
Rising falso dritto to the hands
right foot steps two spans back, left foot steps back behind it

parts.title: Seconda parte
steps: Beat his falso thrust out with the false edge
He takes the bait: rising falso to his right hand
right foot steps to his left side, left foot steps in behind
left foot steps up to the right
right foot steps two spans back, left foot steps strongly back behind it

parts.title: Terza parte
steps: Rising falso: beat his sword strongly to your right
left foot steps up to the right, feet together
right foot steps back beside the left
He takes the bait: feign the parry, void
left foot steps to his right side
left foot steps up to the right
Rising falso dritto to the hands
right foot steps two spans back, then left foot steps behind the right

parts.title: Quarta parte
steps: left foot steps to his right side
Thrust in falsata outside, over his sword, to his left temple
Crossed thrust inside to the face
half mandritto to his right leg
right foot steps back beside the left
left foot steps to his right side
left foot steps up to the right
Rising falso dritto to the hands
right foot steps two spans back, then left foot steps strongly behind the right

parts.title: Quinta parte
steps: Tramazzone beating his sword, thrust in falso over it to his face
rising roverso ridoppio to the arms (or a presa with the left hand)
or: mandritto to the head with a tramazzone
left foot steps to his right side; left foot steps strongly forward; right foot steps to his left side
roverso sgualembrato to his right temple
left foot steps strongly to his right side
right foot steps back behind the left
Embellish: right turn (left foot drawn to the right), left turn
left foot takes a large step to his right

parts.title: Sesta parte
steps: right foot steps strongly forward to the right
Feign a tramazzone to his head
left foot steps toward his right side
Let a roverso drop to his leg
Ponta incrosiata above the hand to his face
left foot steps behind the right

parts.title: Settima parte
steps: Crossed thrust outside his sword to his left temple
rising falso dritto to the hands
left foot steps to his right side, then right foot steps to his left side
left foot steps to his right side
left foot steps behind the right

parts.title: Ottava parte
steps: Rising falso manco strikes his sword
left foot steps up to the right, feet together
right foot steps back beside the left
left foot steps to his right side
left foot steps up to the right
Rising falso to the forward leg
right foot steps two spans back, left foot steps strongly behind it

parts.title: Nona parte
steps: Crossed thrust outside his sword to the face
uncross the arms over his sword
dritto traversato across the throat or face, with a tramazzone
left foot steps to his right side, right foot steps forward, then right foot takes a great step back
Beat his blow out with the false edge
mandritto sgualembrato to the face, tramazzone
right foot steps back to the left
left foot steps to his right side
left foot steps up to the right
right foot steps two spans back, then left foot steps back behind it

parts.title: Decima e ultima parte
steps: step a right turn, then a left turn
left foot steps to the side
Crossed thrust inside, false edge to his true
half mandritto to his right leg
left foot steps behind the right
right foot steps behind the left
Right turn, left foot to the right; left turn, great step
point to the ground, left hand on the pommel, right foot steps to the left heel, right hand on the hip
